poll.q: Aaj ki sab se bari khabar kaun si hai — Claude Fable 5.2, Google ke naye TPU, Tarbela ka dobara hadsa, ya Rawalpindi Test?
options: 🤖 Claude Fable 5.2 — Anthropic ka naya model
🏏 Rawalpindi Test — chaar fifties, do debutants

https://www.reuters.com/technology/anthr.what: Anthropic ne Claude Fable 5.2 (sab ke liye) aur Claude Mythos 5.2 (sirf verified cyber aur life-sciences orgs) launch kiye. Dono ek hi model hain, 30% tez, price $8/$40 per million tokens.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/anthr.why: AI ki race ab sirf 'kaun smart hai' nahi, 'kaun sasta aur kaun safe hai' ban gayi hai. Anthropic IPO se pehle apni position mazboot kar raha hai.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/anthr.next: Dekhna ye hai ke Fable 5.2 asal coding mein OpenAI ke models ko kitna takkar deta hai — aur Mythos ki restricted access par debate kitni tez hoti hai.
https://www.reuters.com/technology/anthr.take: Meri take: Do versions, ek model — Anthropic ne clever tareeqe se 'powerful bhi, safe bhi' ka masla hal kiya hai. Lekin asal sawal ye hai ke ye 'verified access' waqt ke saath aik gatekeeping club na ban jaye.

https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/in.what: Google ne do naye TPU systems diye: 8tx confidential inference ke liye (data use ke waqt bhi protected) aur 8i Max jo double compute aur memory deta hai. Ek saal mein chaar TPU systems — pehli dafa.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/in.why: AI ab sirf chatbot nahi — agents, banks aur governments ka kaam hai. Un sab ko chahiye: bara context aur data ki hifazat. Google dono pe daav laga raha hai.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/in.next: Price aur availability abhi announce nahi hui — agle saal aane ki tawaqqo hai. Asal test tab hoga jab customers Nvidia ke muqable mein TPU ko chunenge ya nahi.
https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/in.take: Meri take: Google chip ki race mein ab 'Nvidia ka alternative' nahi, apna alag rasta bana raha hai. 8tx banks aur sarkaron ko target karta hai — wahan paisa bhi hai aur trust ka sawal bhi. Smart move.

https://www.therobotreport.com/nvidia-la.what: Nvidia ka GR00T 2 robot foundation model — 100,000 ghante ki human video se seekha. 50 tasks mein se 40 bina demo ke complete, paanch demos par 95% success. Saath Isaac Lab 3.0 simulation framework.
https://www.therobotreport.com/nvidia-la.why: Chatbots se aage: ab AI ko haath-pair chahiye. Jo company robots ko sikhane ka standard banayegi, wo agle decade ki Nvidia ban sakti hai.
https://www.therobotreport.com/nvidia-la.next: Foxconn aur Siemens is ko test kar rahe hain — factory floor par asal kaam kab hoga, yehi asal kahani hai. Code December mein aane ki baat hai.
https://www.therobotreport.com/nvidia-la.take: Meri take: Robot ko YouTube video dikha kar kaam sikhana — ye woh idea hai jo pehle sci-fi lagta tha. Lekin yaad rakho: ye lab ke numbers hain, factory ke nahi. Hype aur haqeeqat mein farq abhi baqi hai.

https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/meta-r.what: Meta ne Muse Ember launch kiya — sab se chhota aur sasta Muse model. $0.10 per million input tokens, 1M context, aur Artificial Analysis par Haiku 5.5 ke barabar score, taqreeban aik tihai cost par.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/meta-r.why: Agents ka asal kharcha bari soch nahi, chhote repetitive kaam hain — tool calls, routing, extraction. Jo in ko sasta karega, wo agent economy jeetega.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/meta-r.next: Ab dekhna hai ke developers Ember ko apne agent stacks mein kitni jaldi adopt karte hain — aur kya Meta is price war mein aur neeche jata hai.
https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/09/meta-r.take: Meri take: 'Chhota model, bari baat' — ye Meta ki sab se samajhdar strategy hai. Sab frontier model ki race mein lage hain, Meta ne volume ka kaam pakda hai. Aur volume mein hi paisa hai.

https://www.unite.ai/openai-starts-selli.what: ChatGPT Enterprise ab AWS Marketplace se khareeda ja sakta hai — companies apne AWS bill se pay karein, aur eligible kharch apne AWS commitments mein count karwayen. Features wohi, price private offer par.
https://www.unite.ai/openai-starts-selli.why: Bari companies ke paas AWS ke saath pehle se billion-dollar commitments hain. OpenAI ne un ke paisay ko apni taraf morne ka rasta khol diya hai.
https://www.unite.ai/openai-starts-selli.next: Anthropic pehle se AWS Marketplace par hai — ab dono ki takkar wahan bhi hogi. Aur data residency ke sawal abhi bhi poori tarah hal nahi hue.
https://www.unite.ai/openai-starts-selli.take: Meri take: Ye AI ki khabar kam, business ki khabar zyada hai. Lekin yehi to asli game hai — models to sab bana lete hain, jo procurement jeetega wo enterprise jeetega.

https://www.republicworld.com/global-new.what: Tarbela-5 project mein Tunnel-5 ka bund dobara gir gaya — paani andar bhar gaya, kaam muattal, ek worker beh gaya lekin bach gaya. Inquiry ke mutabiq pehle collapse mein WAPDA, contractor aur consultant teeno zimmedar the.
https://www.republicworld.com/global-new.why: Ye sirf ek dam ka hadsa nahi — 1530 MW ka project, $700 million ke loans, aur cost Rs82bn se Rs317bn. Har collapse ka bill awaam deta hai.
https://www.republicworld.com/global-new.next: High-level inquiry shuru hai — lekin asal sawal ye hai ke July wali inquiry ke baad kya badla? Agar jawab 'kuch nahi' hai to teesra hadsa sirf waqt ki baat hai.
https://www.republicworld.com/global-new.take: Meri take: Doosri dafa wahi ghalti — ye hadsa nahi, system ka failure hai. Design change karna, phir usi ko approve karna, phir flood ko blame karna — ye cycle tab tak chalegi jab tak koi zimmedar thehraya na jaye.

https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.what: Pakistani aur Saudi investors ne Karachi mein ek private equity fund launch kiya — dono mumalik ke darmiyan private sector trade aur investment barhane ki koshish ka hissa.
https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.why: Saudi ke saath rishta ab defence se aage barh kar business mein aa raha hai. Private equity ka matlab hai: ab paisa sirf hukoomati MOUs mein nahi, asal companies mein lagna chahiye.
https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.next: Fund ka size aur pehle investments abhi announce nahi hue — asal khabar tab banegi jab paisa kis sector mein lagta hai ye pata chalega.
https://epaper.dawn.com/DetailNews.php?S.take: Meri take: Fund launch karna aasan hai, fund chalana mushkil. Pakistan mein private equity ka asal test ye hai ke paisa waqai naye business mein jata hai ya sirf purani companies ke haath badalta hai.

https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/fo.what: Pakistan ne Rawalpindi Test ke pehle din 281/5 banaye. Do debutants — Tayyab Arif (57) aur Mohammad Taha (51) — ne fifties lagayen, Babar Azam ne 50 aur Saud Shakeel 57* par not out.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/fo.why: Babar ki captaincy mein nayi team, chaar debutants — aur pehle din hi chaar fifties. Ye woh start hai jo fans ko umeed deta hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/fo.next: Doosre din Shakeel aur Ghori par hai ke Pakistan 400 ke paar jaye. Aur phir bowlers ki baari — Sri Lanka ko jaldi out karna hoga.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/fo.take: Meri take: Debutants ne dhoom macha di — Tayyab ne 51 balls mein 57, ye darne wala debut nahi tha. Lekin Test paanch din ka hota hai, pehla din sirf trailer hai. Asal film abhi baqi hai.

https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pa.what: Allama Iqbal ki 149th youm-e-pedaish par Lahore mein un ke mazar par guard change hua — Pak Navy ne Rangers se duties sambhal leen, Commodore Misbah Ul Amin chief guest the.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pa.why: Iqbal Day sirf chhutti nahi — ye woh din hai jab mulk apne fikri baani ko yaad karta hai. Har saal guard change is ki aik khoobsurat rivaayat hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pa.next: Iqbal ki fikr aaj ke Pakistan mein kitni zinda hai — ye sawal har saal uthta hai, aur jawab humein apne kaam se dena hai, taqreebon se nahi.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pa.take: Meri take: Mazar par phool chadhana achha hai, lekin Iqbal ko asal tribute ye hai ke un ke 'Khudi' wale message ko zindagi mein utaara jaye. Taqreeb khatam, kaam shuru.

https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pm.what: PM Shehbaz Sharif ne Foreign Ministry ko hidayat di ke baarish se doobe Gaza ke liye imdad fori barhayi jaye. Unhon ne Israeli actions ko ceasefire aur international law ki khilaf-warzi qarar diya.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pm.why: Gaza mein baarish ne kheemon mein rehne walon ki mushkil aur barha di hai — bhook, sardi aur paani. Pakistan ki awaaz is waqt un ke liye ahem hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pm.next: Hidayat ke baad asal sawal ye hai ke imdad kitni jaldi aur kis raste se pahunchegi — elaan se delivery tak ka faasla hi asal test hai.
https://www.nation.com.pk/10-Nov-2026/pm.take: Meri take: Bayaan dena zaroori hai, lekin Gaza ko bayaan nahi, samaan chahiye. Pakistan ki imdad ki raftaar hi batayegi ke ye hidayat kitni sanjeeda thi.

https://www.thenews.pk/print/1447958-dar.what: Ishaq Dar aaj Margalla Dialogue 2026 ka iftatah karenge, PM Shehbaz COP31 ke liye Turkiye ja rahe hain, aur Jumeraat se Pakistan Minerals Investment Forum shuru ho raha hai — Reko Diq aur mining par focus.
https://www.thenews.pk/print/1447958-dar.why: Ek hi hafte mein diplomacy, climate aur minerals — Pakistan apni kahani duniya ko bechne ki koshish kar raha hai. Minerals mein asal paisa hai, agar deals waqai hon.
https://www.thenews.pk/print/1447958-dar.next: Mineral Forum mein Barrick aur Ivanhoe Mines ke numainde honge — asal khabar ye hogi ke koi naya investment announce hota hai ya sirf taqreerein hoti hain.
https://www.thenews.pk/print/1447958-dar.take: Meri take: Conferences Pakistan mein kabhi khatam nahi hote — asal farq sirf deals se parta hai. Reko Diq ka naam har forum mein aata hai; ab waqt hai ke naam se aage bhi kuch ho.

mood: 🤖 AI ki race tez, 🏗️ Tarbela phir dooba, 🏏 Test mein naye stars — aaj har taraf 'naya' ka shor hai.
